V. 16.
An—Here the Apoſtle confirm• the Baptiſt's Words: As if he had ſaid He is indeed preferred before thee: So we have experienced: We all—That believe: Have received—All that we enjoy out of his •••ſs; and in the particular, Grace upon grace—One Bleſſing upon another, immeaſurable Grace and Love.
